## What were you trying to learn? / 你想学什么？

Include the mode, language, and goal. Avoid identifying your university class or classmates unless needed.

## What happened? / 实际发生了什么？

Describe what helped or what was confusing. Do not include private grades, student IDs, or another person's conversation.

## Small example / 最小示例

If possible, provide a synthetic prompt and a short output excerpt. Use only materials you have permission to publish; do not upload restricted course handouts or assessment answers.

## What would make it more useful? / 怎样改进会更有帮助？

## Environment / 使用环境

Host, model if known, and Skill commit or version. You can leave unknown details blank.
